specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Lab Build Plates | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Build Plate › paragraph 1
specs.quote: It is magnetically secured to the printer's heatbed and serves as the platform that supports the model.
specs.note: Read from prose, so unverified (§C.6). Stated for Bambu Lab build plates in general (the Build Plate introduction); the store page's Installation Steps say "Lower the plate and secure to the magnetic platform".

specs.value: Flexible design: flex the plate to remove the print
specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Lab Build Plates | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Build Plate › paragraph 1
specs.quote: In addition, the build plate features a flexible design, so once printing is complete, you can simply flex the plate to quickly and easily remove the print.
specs.note: Read from prose, so unverified (§C.6). Stated for Bambu Lab build plates in general; the Textured PEI tab says the same ("simply bend the steel plate and the model will fall right into your hands").

specs.value: Second-generation plates are compatible with the P2S/X2D printer. P2S/X2D printers can physically use first-generation build plates, but the plate type will not be automatically recognized.

documents.note: Linked twice from the plates page (is-valid-page); not cached, so not read for specs.

notes: Sizes per printer come from the plates wiki's Textured PEI Plate tab ("Size | Compatible Models"); its general "Build Plate Dimensions" table says the same. Stored as product.length/product.width per Printer Model option.

The store page's "Usable Print Size" (350*320mm / 256*256mm / 180*180mm), "Packaging Size" and "Packaging Weight" cells list three sizes with no option labels, while the page sells 10 options and the wiki has a fourth size (330*320 mm, H2C / A2L). Packaging values are not mapped to options (that would rest on row order only).
Thickness: the page gives "Stainless Steel Plate - 0.5mm/0.4mm" without saying which size has which; the description prose says 0.5mm. Left to the page row.

Plates wiki Important Notice: the 256×256 mm Textured PEI Plate exists in two generations (first: A1 and X1/P1; second: P2S/X2D, updated QR code; P2S/X2D can physically use first-generation plates without automatic recognition; X1 can use second-generation plates without automatic identification; A1 and P1 fully compatible with second-generation). The store page does not say which generation each 256 mm option ships, so no generation-specific relation is written; the notice's own sentences for each 256 mm printer are option-scoped compat.statement rows (unverified).

Glue: per material only (store page "Glue Stick Required? Yes" for ABS, ASA, PC/PC-CF, PA/PA-CF/PAHT-CF; plates wiki "it may be necessary to apply a layer of glue stick" for PC/PA/ABS/ASA). No unconditional requires relation exists, so none is written; the facts are in the material relations' notes.
Plates wiki: "It is the standard plate included with Bambu lab printers." (an included_in fact; not one of the relation kinds curated here).
Bed temperatures per filament on this plate have no registry key for a plate (print_settings.bed_temp applies to filament only); they are kept in the relations' quotes and notes.
No in-the-box list: neither the store page nor the wiki gives an official packing list for this plate.

Adjudication against the second extraction: printing.usable_print_size per Printer Model was not written. The store row "Usable Print Size" (350*320mm / 256*256mm / 180*180mm) names no model, and the wiki calls the per-model numbers "Size" (Textured PEI tab) and "Build Plate Dimensions"; they are written once, as product.length / product.width per option. The page's own product-scope row stays as published (the H2C/A2L conflict is noted on those options' rows).

Adjudication: part.material from the wiki sentence was not written. The store page's verified table row ("PEI Powder Coating + Magnetic Stainless Steel Plate") already carries the material, and a curated wiki value would outrank and replace it with prose; the wiki's "both sides" detail is part.surface_treatment.

Adjudication: product.length, product.width and product.height are not not_published: length and width are published per Printer Model (the option rows), and the plate's thickness is the page's physical.thickness row. part.color is not_published: neither the plates wiki nor the store page states the plate's colour. part.life_cycle is not_published: the store page says only that the plate "is considered a consumable part, which will degrade over time" (Considerations item 8) and gives no life figure (the store's "Life Cycle" rows hold a duration, e.g. "24 months"); that sentence stays in the description, not as a life-cycle value.

Prose-derived values (part.surface_treatment, part.surface_type, part.mount_type, part.feature, compat.statement) stay unverified (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified); the second extraction had them verified.
